summary: How a client attaches to a pane: replay, the PTY master descriptor, then live output.
framing: Binary. One request line, then a fixed header, then raw bytes until end of file.

messages.name: request
messages.summary: Sent by `axod terminal-attach --shell-id`, once per Ghostty surface. 3 s timeout.

messages.name: acceptance
messages.summary: End of file means the shell exited or the client fell 8 MiB behind; the catalog tells which.

fields.name: descriptor
fields.note: PTY master, for input, resize and termios only

fields.name: stream
fields.note: replay followed by live output until EOF
